fields.Name: T102 - Query Result Entity Link
fields.Description: Runs a multi-row no-parameter query and interacts with the results grid (sort/click).

InputDefinition.goal: Navigate to Data Explorer > Queries. Find and Run a no-parameter Approved query (use the 'Search queries...' sidebar box or a visible folder query like 'Entities with Field Counts'). Once results display in the grid, interact with the results — click a column header to sort, or click a result row — and verify the grid responds. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A no-parameter query was run and results displayed in a grid
Interacting with the results grid (sort or row click) produced a visible response
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
